mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have partly cloudy skies and a temperature of 64 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park, though the air quality index is currently at a moderate 53.

The City of Verona is currently recruiting for an Engineering Technician to manage municipal construction projects, and residents are reminded that sewer and stormwater utility rates were recently adjusted to ensure our infrastructure remains self-supporting and reliable.

There is plenty to do around town with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company both happening today, while tomorrow you can check out the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy the music series at Paddy Mac's.

On Friday, August 15, Verona police officers performed a welfare check on a driver near North Main Street and Cross Country Road, ultimately arresting the individual for an O W I after she was found passed out in her vehicle.

Today is the perfect day to stop by for the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open at 10:00 AM, and you can look forward to Raspberry Cheesecake tomorrow.
